relationships.subject: RhoA
relationships.evidence_quote: Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and mass spectrometry identified tropomyosin 4 (TPM4) as a RhoA-interacting protein.

relationships.subject: RhoA
relationships.evidence_quote: RhoA overexpression in normal rats promoted inflammatory pain-like behaviors and sarcomere contraction via ERK signaling pathway activation.

relationships.subject: TPM4
relationships.evidence_quote: TPM4 knockdown in MTrPs attenuated inflammatory pain-like behaviors and sarcomere contraction and suppressed ERK signaling pathway activation in MTrP rats.

key_findings: RhoA is upregulated in rat myofascial trigger points and promotes inflammatory pain-like behavior and sarcomere contraction via ERK.
TPM4 is a RhoA-interacting protein whose knockdown attenuates these changes.
